title: Zero values
hints: `var i int` declares `i` and sets it to the zero value `0`. You never need to write the value yourself.
Group the declarations: `var ( i int; s string; ... )` with one per line, then print each with `fmt.Printf("%T = %v\n", i, i)`.
Eight `Printf` calls in the listed order. For the string variable use `fmt.Printf("%T = %q\n", s, s)` so it prints `string = ""`.
